constraints: If assertions are disabled (via SET ASSERT ENABLED), Asserted simply returns boolExpression's value without ever raising an error; if enabled and boolExpression is false, it raises error -10518 exactly like ASSERT before still returning the (false) result.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Evaluates and returns boolExpression's value, additionally raising an ASSERT-style error -10518 as a side effect if the value is false and assertions are enabled.
